description: This PHP class 'BuzzPhoto' is an entity representing a photo associated with a buzz post in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for the photo data, metadata such as filename, type, size, dimensions, and relationships to the BuzzPost.

classes.name: BuzzPhoto
classes.description: Entity class representing a photo associated with a buzz post, including properties for photo data and metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the photo.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the photo.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Returns the BuzzPost associated with this photo.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost with this photo.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Retrieves the photo data, which may be a resource or string.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Gets the filename of the photo.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the photo.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the size of the photo.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the photo.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of the photo.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the photo.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Retrieves the height of the photo.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the photo.
